name: executePythonScript
description: Execute a Python script. Python gives you full scripting capability.
code:
import json, os, sys
args = json.loads(os.environ.get("GURU_TOOL_ARGS", "{}"))
script = args.get("script", "")
if not script:
    print(json.dumps({"error": "No script provided"}))
    sys.exit(1)
try:
    exec(script)
except Exception as e:
    print(json.dumps({"error": str(e)}))
    sys.exit(1)
